mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 37 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park, and we have a waxing gibbous moon overhead.

The city is evaluating a space needs proposal to expand the Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our residents, and construction continues on the Mark Drive and Legion Street reconstruction projects.

You can catch live music at Bailey's Run today, with more performances at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's coming up tomorrow and throughout the week, plus yoga and various trivia nights starting this Sunday.
Regarding local activity, on November 4, a driver was arrested for O W I in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue after a crash involving a passenger under 16 years old.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's, and the shop opens today at 10:00 AM.
